name: KamLAND2
summary: KamLAND2 upgrades the Kamioka liquid-scintillator observatory after the original KamLAND campaign ended in August 2024. Improved light collection and response target precision low-energy neutrino studies and support the related xenon-loaded double-beta programme.
detection_principle: A large scintillator target detects optical light from electron recoils and inverse beta decay. Upgraded photosensors, light collection and scintillator performance improve energy resolution; isotope-loaded KamLAND2-Zen is a related configuration rather than identical physics programme.
